server_path.markdownDescription:
The path to the server binary to use for starting the language server. Use `auto` for the package to manage (install/update) server automatically.

> [!NOTE]
> Change this instead of directly updating `command` - the `${server_path}` variable is dynamically resolved based on this setting.

> [!WARNING]
> Using custom binary could result in package settings not matching what server supports.

metrics.description: Send metrics to Semgrep to help improve our products and services. Telemetry data includes scan metrics, extension runtime version details, and other information as described here: https://semgrep.dev/docs/metrics#data-collected-as-metrics.

scan.configuration.description: Each item can be a YAML configuration file, directory of YAML files ending in .yml | .yaml, URL of a configuration file, or Semgrep registry entry name. Use "auto" to automatically obtain rules tailored to this project; your project URL will be used to log in to the Semgrep registry.

scan.exclude.description: List of files or directories to exclude.

scan.include.description: List of files or directories to include.

scan.jobs.description: Number of parallel jobs to run. (does not apply to experimental language server)

scan.maxMemory.description: Maximum memory to use in megabytes.

scan.maxTargetBytes.description: Maximum size of target in bytes to scan.

scan.timeout.description: Maximum time to scan in seconds.

scan.timeoutThreshold.description: Maximum number of rules that can timeout on a file before the file is skipped. If set to 0 will not have limit. Defaults to 3.

scan.onlyGitDirty.description: Only scan lines changed since the last commit

scan.pro_intrafile.description: Enable intrafile scanning using the Semgrep Pro Engine (requires Pro Engine to be already installed)

scan.secrets.description: (experimental) Enable secrets scanning using the Semgrep Pro Engine (requires Pro Engine and experimental language server)

doHover.description: Enable hovering for AST node viewing (requires restart)
